InitDetectedControllerSlot sets it for joysticks and the mouse (types 2, 3) and gives axis bindings only then.
StageObject_ReadCarControllerMapping enables axis steering only when set; FrontendControls_IsSelectedAxisBound for entries 0/1.
StageObject_ReadCarControllerMapping enables axis throttle and brake only when set; entries 2/3 in FrontendControls_IsSelectedAxisBound.
Copied from DeviceInfo::supportsForceFeedback; the calibration page leads to the pad page and StageTiming_InitForceFeedbackSlots creates effects only when set.
StageObject_UpdatePlayerControlIndicators, throttle and brake on one axis: the positive half is the throttle when set, the negative half otherwise.
StageObject_UpdatePlayerControlIndicators sets Car::steeringInputMode 1 when set, else 2; mode 2 snaps the wheel angle to the target in AutoGear_IntegrateSteeringAccumulator, mode 1 eases it.
